verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms docs.readme.com serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) that also documents a full-content variant via appending .md to any page URL — matching the story's ask exactly. This is reinforced by ReadMe's own docs being organized under numerous /llms.txt paths (e.g. customizing-docs/llms.txt, workflows/llms.txt, ai/llms.txt) and a dedicated 'AI Discoverability' feature (readme-docs-10/31/65) that scores published docs against an 'Agent-Friendly Docs spec,' indicating llms.txt generation is a first-class, cross-project capability rather than a one-off. Missing for 10: explicit first-party confirmation that llms.txt is auto-generated for arbitrary customer-published hubs (not just docs.readme.com itself), and independent/community corroboration of this specific feature.
